description: Financial Analyst API — FX P&L. Decompose investment returns into local asset performance and currency movement contribution. Given entry and exit prices in any currency pair with dated interim cash flows, returns total USD P&L, annualized return, and the exact basis points attributable to FX versus the underlying position. Applicable to cross-border private equity, international fixed income, commodity positions, and any multi-currency investment where currency attribution matters.
